evidence: The audited SAM 3D Body/MHR repository and supplied assets expose mesh faces and kinematic data but no reviewed vertex-to-body-part segmentation contract.
decision: No coordinate threshold or hand-authored medical/torso region was invented. Per-region Official-versus-E1 error is therefore not reported.
